answer: Time-locked physical presence proofs. Each identity must periodically appear at a registered physical jetty, where a tamper-evident beacon records a signed timestamp; gaps or missed windows void the identity. Registration requires a fresh visit to an unregistered ledge terminal, and renewal windows shrink toward a fixed horizon, so maintaining many identities demands continuous human presence. An attacker pays repeated travel and dwell time per identity, not money, capping farms by real-world throughput.
